steps.title: Design the cover
steps.detail: Draw a hollow shape for your night light cover that fits in your hand.

steps.title: Check the sizes
steps.detail: Make sure your cover leaves enough space inside for the warm LED and circuit.

steps.title: Ask staff for help
steps.detail: Email lvy@usc.edu to ask what you can use and when.
